name: Josephoenix
bio: Josephoenix takes songs you already know by heart and turns them inside out, with funk grooves, jazz-style solos and a lot of soul. A big voice out front and a rhythm section and keys that like to stretch out mean a familiar chorus can turn into something new halfway through. Bring dancing shoes: they describe themselves as a bottomless barrel of grooves with a twist.
bio_source: Written by TOPA from josephoenix.com and @josephoenixband.
